title: Platinum (II) complex of isopentyl glycine ligand: DNA binding, molecular dynamic, and anticancer activity against breast cancer.
authors: Eslami Moghadam, Mahboube; Tavakoli Hafshajani, Khadijeh; Sohrabi, Nasrin; Rezaeisadat, Morteza; Oftadeh, Mohsen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铂配合物与ct-DNA的沟槽结合，结合光谱实验、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，虽属蛋白质-DNA互作范畴但对象为小分子-DNA，非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: In this paper, we performed thorough experimental and theoretical calculations to examine the interaction between Pt derivative, as an anticancer, and ct-DNA. The mode of DNA binding with [Pt(NH(3))(2)(Isopentylgly)]NO(3), where Isopentylgly is Isopentyl glycine, was evaluated by various spectroscopic methods, docking, and molecular dynamics simulation studies. UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopic titration results and CD spectra of DNA-drug showed this interaction is via groove binding. Also, thermal stability studies or DNA melting temperature changes (DeltaT(m)), as well as the quenching emissions monitoring proved it. Also, the thermodynamic parameter and binding constant displayed that complex-DNA formation is a spontaneous process, and H-binding and also groove binding were found to be the main forces. Theoretical studies stated [Pt(NH(3))(2)(Isopentylgly)]NO(3)-DNA formation occurs on C-G center on DNA, along with rising DNA-compound stability. IC(50) value against the human breast cell line probably is due to the Isopentyl glycine ligand in the structure of the Pt compound, and it was obtained more than cisplatin and less than carboplatin against the MCF7 cell.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 本文中，我们进行了全面的实验和理论计算，以考察作为抗癌药物的Pt衍生物与ct-DNA之间的相互作用。通过多种光谱方法、对接和分子动力学模拟研究，评估了[Pt(NH(3))(2)(Isopentylgly)]NO(3)（其中Isopentylgly为异戊基甘氨酸）与DNA的结合模式。UV-Vis和荧光光谱滴定结果以及DNA-药物的CD光谱表明，这种相互作用是通过沟槽结合实现的。此外，热稳定性研究或DNA熔解温度变化（DeltaT(m)）以及淬灭发射监测也证实了这一点。同时，热力学参数和结合常数表明，复合物-DNA的形成是一个自发过程，氢键结合和沟槽结合是主要作用力。理论研究指出，[Pt(NH(3))(2)(Isopentylgly)]NO(3)-DNA的形成发生在DNA的C-G中心，并伴随着DNA-化合物稳定性的提高。针对人乳腺癌细胞系的IC(50)值可能归因于Pt化合物结构中的异戊基甘氨酸配体，且该值在MCF7细胞上高于顺铂而低于卡铂。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
